cases.description: Valid login takes each role to its own dashboard
cases.steps:
1. Open /login/
2. Enter username and password
3. Submit
cases.expected: Admin, Faculty and Student dashboards respectively
cases.actual: admin landed on /dashboard/admin/ (dashboard shown); faculty1 landed on /dashboard/faculty/ (dashboard shown); student1 landed on /dashboard/student/ (dashboard shown)

cases.description: Wrong password is refused with a message
cases.steps:
1. Open /login/
2. Enter a wrong password
3. Submit
cases.expected: Login page shown again with an error; no session
cases.actual: Stayed on /login/; error message shown; session cookie not set

cases.description: Every page needs a login
cases.steps: 1. Open each protected URL without logging in
cases.expected: Each request is redirected to /login/
cases.actual: /dashboard/ -> 302 /login/; /students/ -> 302 /login/; /attendance/select/ -> 302 /login/; /reports/ -> 302 /login/; /audit/ -> 302 /login/; /percentage/ -> 302 /login/

cases.description: Each role reaches only its own pages
cases.preconditions: Logged in as student1, then as faculty1
cases.steps:
1. As a student, open admin and faculty pages
2. As faculty, open admin pages
cases.expected: 403 Forbidden for every page outside the role
cases.actual: student /students/ -> 403; student /audit/ -> 403; student /attendance/select/ -> 403; student /subjects/ -> 403; faculty /students/ -> 403; faculty /audit/ -> 403; faculty /subjects/ -> 403

cases.description: Account locks after 5 failed logins
cases.preconditions: faculty2 not used in this run
cases.steps:
1. Submit 5 wrong passwords for faculty2
2. Try the correct password
cases.expected: 6th attempt refused with HTTP 429 and a lockout message, even with the right password
cases.actual: After 5 failures the correct password returned HTTP 429 with the lockout page

cases.description: Admin adds a student, who can then log in
cases.preconditions: Logged in as admin; class CSE-5A exists
cases.steps:
1. Students -> Add
2. Fill the form
3. Save
4. Log in as the new student
cases.data: SRN PES2UG24CS200, name Test Student, test@example.com, CSE-5A, password Welcome@123
cases.expected: Student listed; the new login reaches the student dashboard
cases.actual: Saved (Added Test Student (PES2UG24CS200).); listed: True; new login reached the student dashboard

cases.description: Search students by SRN or name
cases.steps:
1. Students
2. Search by part of the SRN, then by name
cases.expected: Only matching students listed
cases.actual: q=CS200 listed 1 SRN(s) incl. PES2UG24CS200; q=test student found it: True

cases.description: Edit, then deactivate a student (never deleted)
cases.steps:
1. Edit the student's name
2. Deactivate the student
3. List, then list with 'show all'
cases.data: Name changed to Test Student Two
cases.expected: Name updated; hidden from the active list; still shown under 'all'
cases.actual: renamed: True; hidden from active list: True; still in 'all': True

cases.description: Admin adds a faculty member
cases.steps:
1. Faculty -> Add
2. Fill the form
3. Save
cases.expected: Faculty member listed
cases.actual: Added Test Faculty.; listed: True

cases.description: Admin adds a subject and a time slot
cases.steps:
1. Subjects -> Add, save
2. Time slots -> Add, save
cases.data: UE24CS399A Test Subject sem 5; slot 'Test slot' 18:00-19:00
cases.expected: Both listed
cases.actual: subject listed: True; time slot listed: True

cases.description: Admin assigns a subject and class to a faculty member
cases.steps:
1. Subject Assignments
2. Pick faculty, subject, class
3. Assign
cases.expected: Assignment listed
cases.actual: assignment listed: True

cases.description: Faculty sees only their assigned class/subject pairs
cases.preconditions: Logged in as faculty1 (teaches UE24CS341A to CSE-5A and CSE-5B)
cases.steps:
1. Mark Attendance
2. Read the list
cases.expected: Exactly the 2 assigned pairs; Computer Networks / DBMS not offered
cases.actual: 2 class/subject pairs offered; other faculty's subjects shown: False

cases.description: Faculty marks a class for one slot
cases.steps:
1. Select CSE-5A / UE24CS341A
2. Pick today and slot 1
3. Mark the first student Absent, others Present
4. Save
cases.expected: Confirmation 'Saved attendance for N students, 1 slot'
cases.actual: Saved attendance for 4 students, 1 slot, on 30 Oct 2026.

cases.description: The same class, date and slot can't be saved twice
cases.steps:
1. Open the same sheet
2. Same date and slot
3. Save
cases.expected: Refused with 'already saved'; nothing new stored
cases.actual: Attendance for Period 1 on 30 Oct 2026 is already saved. Nothing was saved this time; use Modify attendance to change it.

cases.description: A future date is refused
cases.steps:
1. Open the sheet
2. Pick tomorrow
3. Save
cases.expected: Refused: attendance can't be marked for a future date
cases.actual: Attendance can't be marked for a future date.

cases.description: Faculty can't open a class or subject they don't teach
cases.steps: 1. Type the URL of faculty2's class/subject sheet
cases.expected: Refused (403 or 404); no sheet shown
cases.actual: HTTP 404

cases.description: A correction without a reason is refused
cases.steps:
1. Modify -> today, slot 1
2. Change a status
3. Save with an empty reason
cases.expected: Refused: a reason is required; nothing changed
cases.actual: Please give a reason for the change (at least a few words).

cases.description: A correction with a reason is saved and logged
cases.steps:
1. Modify -> today, slot 1
2. Change the absent student to Present
3. Reason given
4. Save
5. Admin opens the audit log
cases.expected: 'Updated 1 record'; audit log has the change and the reason
cases.actual: Updated 1 record.; audit entry with reason: True

cases.description: Student sees their percentage per subject
cases.preconditions: ST-13: student1 marked; faculty marks one more slot absent for student1
cases.steps:
1. Log in as student1
2. Open My Attendance
cases.expected: Percentage shown per subject, matching the marked classes
cases.actual: UE24CS341A shown as 50.0% (1 present of 2 classes)

cases.description: Admin sets the threshold; low students are warned
cases.steps:
1. Admin -> Attendance threshold -> 60 -> Save
2. student1 opens the dashboard
3. faculty1 opens the dashboard
cases.expected: Saved; student1 sees a low-attendance warning; faculty1 sees student1 in the below-threshold list
cases.actual: Threshold set to 60%.; student warning: True; on faculty list: True

cases.description: Student sees their history, newest first
cases.steps:
1. Log in as student1
2. Open My History
cases.expected: Each marked class listed with date, slot, subject and status
cases.actual: 3 entries for UE24CS341A, statuses shown

cases.description: A student can't open another student's records
cases.steps: 1. Type the URL of another student's history and report
cases.expected: Refused (403 or 404)
cases.actual: /history/student/2/ -> HTTP 403; /reports/student/2/ -> HTTP 403

cases.description: Subject-wise report for a date range
cases.preconditions: ST-13 done; logged in as faculty1
cases.steps:
1. Reports -> subject report for CSE-5A / UE24CS341A
2. Enter a date range covering today
cases.expected: Every student of the class with classes held, attended and %, low ones marked
cases.actual: HTTP 200; 4 students listed with percentages

cases.description: Student-wise and class-wise reports (admin)
cases.preconditions: ST-13 done; logged in as admin
cases.steps:
1. Reports -> search a student -> open
2. Reports -> class CSE-5A
cases.expected: Both reports open with the marked data
cases.actual: student report: HTTP 200; class report: HTTP 200

cases.description: Download a report as CSV
cases.steps:
1. Open the subject report
2. Download CSV
cases.expected: A CSV file with a header row and one row per student
cases.actual: text/csv; charset=utf-8; attachment; filename="sams-ue24cs341a-cse-5a-subject-wise-report-20261030.csv"; 7 lines; header: UE24CS341A CSE-5A subject-wise report

cases.description: Download a report as PDF; print view
cases.steps:
1. Open the subject report
2. Download PDF
3. Check the print button and print styles
cases.expected: A valid PDF file; the page has a Print button and hides navigation when printed
cases.actual: application/pdf, 2409 bytes, starts with %PDF-: True; print view: True

cases.description: Admin actions, refusals and failed logins are logged
cases.steps:
1. Admin -> Audit Log
2. Filter by outcome
cases.expected: Entries of all three kinds, with user and time
cases.actual: SUCCESS: 9 entries, DENIED: 8 entries, FAILED: 7 entries

cases.description: Main pages answer within 3 seconds
cases.steps: 1. Open each main page as its role, timing each request
cases.expected: Every page under 3 s
cases.actual: 16 pages; slowest /reports/subject/1/1/?format=pdf at 75 ms; median 10 ms

cases.description: Health check reports the server and database
cases.steps: 1. Open /health/ without logging in
cases.expected: HTTP 200 'ok' (503 if the database is down)
cases.actual: HTTP 200: {"status": "ok"}

cases.description: Session cookie is protected; logout ends the session
cases.steps:
1. Log in, read the session cookie flags
2. Log out
3. Open the dashboard again
cases.expected: Cookie Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite; after logout the dashboard redirects to /login/
cases.actual: session cookie flags {'Secure': True, 'HttpOnly': True, 'SameSite': True}; after logout /dashboard/ -> 302 /login/

cases.description: Every page has a title, a way home and a way out
cases.steps:
1. Open each role's main pages
2. Check page title, home link, Logout button
cases.expected: All present on every page
cases.actual: all pages have title, home and logout

cases.description: 20 users at once
cases.steps: 1. 20 users log in and open 5 pages each, at the same time
cases.expected: No errors; 95% of pages under 3 s
cases.actual: 20 users, 100 page views in 2.8 s; errors 0; median 124 ms, 95th percentile 147 ms
